tracking.description: Clicks and indicative opens on this send (P3-4); zeros until it is sent and tracked.

label.description: A person’s name, a company’s, a deal’s; a plain label when unreadable.

kind.description: `task_assigned`: someone else assigned the task to you (a sequence’s task step included). `task_due`: it came due. `transfer_*` (OWN-1): a record offered to you, your offer decided, or a manager moved a record to or from you. `guardrail_repeat_blocks` (GUARD-1): a member was stopped three times in a day from mailing others’ leads. `guardrail_alert` (REP-1): a sender-reputation finding about your mailbox, or (at high severity) a member’s. `invoice_needs_review` (INV-1): an invoice on a deal waits for finance. `invoice_coverage_lost` (INV-1): a refund left a deal’s verified invoices short of its amount. `guardrail_poach_suspected` (GUARD-2): a member mailed your lead, or (as a reviewer) another member’s lead or a customer. `cadence_warning` (CADENCE-1): a lead of yours missed its follow-up cadence and rotates after the grace unless touched. `cadence_rotated` (CADENCE-1): a lead was rotated to the next rep (its `transfer`).

target.description: What it is about, whatever the kind (GUARD-2): one polymorphic target.

guardrail.description: For a `guardrail_*` kind (GUARD-1): the event, who it is about, and the day’s count.

message.description: What the event said (REP-1: the alert’s own words).

owner.description: GUARD-2: whose lead it was; null for none.

address.description: GUARD-2: whom the mail went to.

subject.description: GUARD-2: the mail’s subject. Never its body.

sentAt.description: GUARD-2: when the mail was sent.

invoice.description: For an `invoice_*` kind (INV-1): the invoice waiting for finance, and its deal.

cadence.description: For `cadence_warning` (CADENCE-1): the lapsed deal, and when it rotates.

unread.description: How many of all your notifications are unread.

taskDigest.description: The daily email of tasks due or overdue.

taskTitle.description: `task` steps: a task on the person for their owner (else the enroller), due when the step runs.

tracking.description: `email` steps: clicks and indicative opens across its sends (P3-4).

timeZone.description: Used when a recipient's zone cannot be inferred.

days.description: Monday-first bitmask: bit 0 Monday … bit 6 Sunday.

ownerMemberId.description: Whose sequence it is (#192): who made it, or whose API key did; null when neither is known.

visibility.description: `shared`: everyone who may enrol sees it. `private`: its owner and admins only; to anyone else it is not found (#192).

stepId.description: The task step that made it.

enrolledByMemberId.description: The member who enrolled the person: the sender of each step's send (#144).

countryUnknownAtEnrol.description: No country was known at enrolment (D-251); the region policy applies once one is.

tasks.description: The tasks its task steps made, in step order (#158). Completing one drives nothing.

skipped.description: Already in this sequence: a no-op, never a second enrolment.

message.description: The server's reason, naming the rule.

warnings.description: Enrolled, flagged for review — never blocking (D-251: no known country).

changedBy.description: The member, by name; null once removed.

reviewReason.description: #242: an automatic (`won_deal`) exclusion whose deal was reopened or fully refunded waits for an admin: remove it, or dismiss the flag.

wonExclusionScope.description: `address`: a won deal excludes its point of contact’s primary address. `domain`: their company’s domain (free-mail domains fall back to the address).

url.description: Public, https and unguessable; mail clients load it without a sign-in.

value.description: The fact; null unless answered — never an empty string.

applied.description: Whether the answer was written to the record’s field.

pending.description: A run for the record is queued or going.

platformAdmin.description: Whether the caller may use the platform routes: a verified address in PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS.

url.description: The link to send; built from the server’s WEB_URL.

pendingInvites.description: Invitations to the admin role not yet accepted (the owner’s, until they join).

created.description: `false` when the idempotency key was seen before.

apiKeyLast4.description: The key itself is never returned.

createMembers.description: The accounts option as last chosen at a start (#184): the workspace’s saved choice, which a scheduled run (#185) uses. Null for off.

remote.description: Twenty’s own count when the pass started.

before.description: Records of this object mapped here when the pass started.

missingInSource.description: A reconcile pass (#156): mapped records of this object Twenty no longer returns, flagged for review; null for any other pass.

conflicts.description: Records with a field edited in BylineCRM after Twenty last touched the record (#185): BylineCRM’s value was kept for those fields. Counted beside the outcomes, not instead of one.

kept.description: Which fields were kept, per record, for the first records of the pass.

nextRunAt.description: When the schedule next starts a run; null while off.

failures.description: Scheduled runs failed in a row; 0 after a success.

cutoverAt.description: When an admin stopped syncing for good; cleared once syncing is turned back on.

externalId.description: The Twenty id the record was mapped from.

name.description: The local record’s name, or the link’s label.

scheduled.description: Started by the automatic sync (#185), not a person.

createMembers.description: The accounts option the run was started with (#184): the role its accounts got.

accountsCreated.description: Accounts (a user and a seat) this run made for Twenty members who were not here (#184).

accountsToCreate.description: Twenty members with a usable address and no seat here (#184): what the accounts option would create; null when they could not be read.

refreshTokenLast4.description: The refresh token and client secret themselves are never returned.

merged.description: Linked to a record BylineCRM had: the same Bigin record imported from Twenty, a person by address, a company by domain.

missingInSource.description: Mapped records Bigin deleted, flagged by this run for review; never deleted here.

unknownStages.description: Deals whose Bigin stage has no stage here: placed in the first open stage.

reused.description: Contacts edited in Bigin to hold a different person: the earlier person kept, a new one made, the link moved.

ownersFilled.description: Matched records with no owner given Bigin's owner (a deal without one: its point of contact's). Existing owners are never changed.

failedRecords.description: Records that failed across every module.

skipped.description: Deals left in place: someone moved them by hand after Bigin last changed them.

source.description: `bigin`: Bigin's Deals Stage picklist; `imported`: Bigin unreadable, the stages imported deals carry.

stageId.description: The explicit mapping; null when left to the name match.

unread.description: Imported deals whose link has no Bigin stage yet; a full run fills them.

secretPrefix.description: The secret's name; the secret itself is never shown again.

previousSecretExpiresAt.description: While a rotation's grace window is open: until when the previous secret still signs.

RequestId.description: The id of this request; quote it when reporting a problem. An inbound well-formed id is echoed.
